title: Meta joins with group of companies to tame ‘chaos’ of doing business with AI bots
key_facts: Meta partners with Walmart, Stripe and Sierra Technologies on new standards for how AI agents interact with businesses
Standard is called the Personal Agent Protocol
Introduced by Sierra co-founder Bret Taylor, who is also chairman of OpenAI Group PBC
Aims to handle authentication and give companies visibility into agent activity
Taylor says it is open for anyone to implement and expects OpenAI to back it in future
Appears to respond to a paper from six major banks, including Bank of America and Capital One, urging standards and protections
Meta's David Singleton compares it to email as a common standard
quote_evidence: “We’re designing it to handle authentication, empower consumers and give companies visibility into what personal agents do through their websites, APIs or company agents,” Taylor wrote in a blog post.
Taylor, who is also chairman of OpenAI Group PBC, said he expects that the AI giant will also back the standard in the future.
why_it_matters_hint: Common rules for how personal AI agents identify themselves to businesses could make agent shopping safer and easier to trust.
